title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B Q4_K_M GGUF on llama.cpp, DGX Spark
slug_note: Liquid's 24B-A2B agent model served by llama.cpp on the Spark: 107 tok/s at 8K context.

variation.license: LFM Open License v1.0 (free for commercial use under $10M annual revenue)
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 14.7 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (--ctx-size 8192).

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start). On Ubuntu / DGX OS install libssl-dev first, or -hf cannot download.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (623-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) with --ctx-size 8192

caveats: Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-GGUF:Q4_K_M --ctx-size 8192 -ngl 99` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 20 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 14.7 GiB (weights + KV at --ctx-size 8192).
The two other LFM2.5-24B-A2B recipes in this directory carry vendor (M5 Max) and builder (RTX 3060) numbers; this one is the first box-tier row for the model.
